# langsmith_tools (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith platform-level tool definitions in a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all platform tools in the workspace.
data "langsmith_tools" "all" {}

output "tool_handles" {
  value = [for t in data.langsmith_tools.all.tools : t.handle]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID to list tools from. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `tools` (Attributes List) The tools defined in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))

<a id="nestedatt--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the tool.
- `description` (String) The tool description shown to model callers.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the tool is enabled.
- `handle` (String) The stable handle used to reference the tool.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the tool.
- `metadata` (String) JSON-encoded free-form metadata.
- `name` (String) The display name of the tool.
- `parameters` (String) JSON-encoded JSON Schema object describing the tool's input parameters.
- `returns` (String) JSON-encoded JSON Schema object describing the tool's return type.
- `updated_at` (String) The last modification timestamp of the tool.
